answer: None of the provided articles tells customers to use a retired form. The only retired form mentioned is NW-POA-1, in "When more than one person owns the car," and that article directs owners to its replacement, NW-POA-2. Its note that an NW-POA-1 signed before February 1, 2026 is accepted until June 30, 2026 is now past, so that sentence is outdated, but it doesn't tell customers to use the retired form. The articles give no indication that any other form they mention (NW-EST-1, NW-LPA-1, NW-MIL-1, NW-PU-1) has been retired.
